scope.device: 2D n-IGZO electron-only drift-diffusion teaching model with the T02-A enabled symmetric dual-gate stack
scope.purpose: Freeze the formal isolated NTA and NGA transfer-sensitivity points, extraction methods, failure retention, persisted outputs, acceptance gates, and evidence boundary after the separate equation smoke passed.
fixed_variables: NGA = 0 cm^-3 eV^-1 throughout every NTA-family device
NTA = 0 cm^-3 eV^-1 throughout every NGA-family device
bottom and top interface D_it = 0 cm^-2 eV^-1
donor-like NTD and NGD = 0 and deferred
channel length = 10 um and width = 60 um
channel thickness = 24 nm
top and bottom physical Al2O3 thickness = 30 nm
top and bottom dielectric relative permittivity = 6.8
interface_4x mesh
source voltage = 0 V and drain voltage = 0.01 V
top gate is swept and bottom gate is fixed at 0 V
300 K constant teaching mobility = 35.5 cm2/(V*s)
ideal ohmic source and drain
Poisson plus electron continuity with quasi-static occupied bulk-trap charge
no recombination, dynamic capture-emission, ferroelectric polarization, or non-ideal contacts
prohibited_work_before_contract_pass: formal NTA or NGA DEVSIM transfer run
simultaneous nonzero NTA and NGA in one attribution device
simultaneous interface D_it and bulk-trap variation
P3, P5, compact-model, SPICE, circuit, layout, PEX, or HZO work
prohibited_claims_after_future_run: project-device DOS measurement, extraction, fitting, or calibration
physical or measured SS, VTH, Ioff, Ion, mobility, or process prediction
dynamic capture-emission, hysteresis, bias-stress, reliability, or complete four-band DOS validation
experimental calibration, uncertainty validation, compact-model, circuit, layout, PEX, or HZO evidence

execution_order: run the NTA family from a fresh device for each of its four values while NGA and both interface D_it values remain zero
run the NGA family from a fresh device for each of its four values while NTA and both interface D_it values remain zero
for every device solve all-zero-bias Poisson and coupled equilibrium
apply the T02-C low-VDS ladder with both gates at 0 V
precondition the top gate from 0 V down to -0.5 V
sweep the exact 31-point top-gate grid upward from -0.5 V to 1.0 V
save the VTG=0.3 V state and delete the device before the next value

constant_current_vth_proxy.name: constant_current_log_interpolation
constant_current_vth_proxy.interpolation: linear primary-gate-voltage interpolation in log10(abs(drain current per unit width))

delta_vth_proxy.name: within-family constant-current threshold shift
delta_vth_proxy.reference_rule: Use the separately executed zero control of the same family

gm_proxy.name: central_difference_then_linear_interpolation
gm_proxy.definition: central-difference derivative of abs(drain current) versus primary-gate voltage, linearly interpolated at VTH + 0.2 V

ss_proxy.name: fixed_current_window_ols
ss_proxy.endpoint_method: log-current interpolation to exact fixed-window endpoints
ss_proxy.fit: ordinary least squares of top-gate voltage versus log10(abs(drain current per unit width))

low_gate_current_proxy.name: fixed_lowest_gate_voltage_current
low_gate_current_proxy.definition: abs(drain current) at VTG=-0.5 V, VBG=0 V, and VDS=0.01 V

registered: Increasing occupied acceptor-like bulk states may increase the VTH and SS numerical proxies.
Increasing occupied acceptor-like bulk states may reduce common-bias mobile-electron density, drain-current, and gm numerical proxies.
directional_hypotheses.failure_rule: A finite, converged, conserved, independently reproducible contrary or non-monotonic trend is retained and reported rather than converted into a stage failure.
directional_hypotheses.reason: The source stack, drain bias, and material assumptions differ from the project teaching stack, so direction is diagnostic rather than a completion gate.

electron_current_density.source_model: DEVSIM ElectronCurrent edge model projected by element_from_edge_model

required_failure_artifacts: all completed transfer rows and metrics
all completed state files and manifest entries
runner report with the exact failed acceptance gate
figures when enough persisted data exist
failure_retention.acceptance_change_rule: Any extraction-window or threshold change requires a new config revision, a recorded rationale, preservation of the prior failed contract/report, and a complete rerun.
prohibited_recovery: drop a literature point after seeing its result
reuse a partially solved device as a replacement control

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim_after_contract_pass: The formal isolated NTA/NGA transfer-sensitivity points, unchanged teaching-model equations, extraction methods, failure-retention policy, output files, laptop budget, acceptance gates, and evidence boundary have been frozen and statically checked without running DEVSIM.
evidence_boundary.allowed_claim_after_future_run_and_indep: The isolated NTA and NGA literature-constrained point sets completed controlled transfer sensitivities in the frozen quasi-static teaching model; VTH, SS, low-gate current, gm, and internal-state responses remain numerical proxies.
prohibited_claims: the formal NTA/NGA transfer sensitivity passed before both the runner and independent persisted-evidence check pass
project-device DOS was measured, extracted, fitted, calibrated, or assigned physical uncertainty
SS, VTH, Ioff, Ion, mobility, or process behavior was physically or experimentally validated
dynamic capture-emission, hysteresis, bias-stress, reliability, NTD, NGD, or complete four-band DOS was validated
P2, T03, compact-model, circuit, layout, PEX, or HZO work completed before its own stage gate
evidence_boundary.next_gate: Only this formal contract PASS permits the separate formal NTA/NGA transfer run. P3, P5, M00, M01, SPICE, circuits, layout, PEX, and HZO remain closed until the formal runner and independent persisted-evidence check pass and P2 completion is documented.

literature_input.title: Numerical Study of Sub-Gap Density of States Dependent Electrical Characteristics in Amorphous In-Ga-Zn-O Thin-Film Transistors
literature_input.source_device_context: top-contact bottom-gate staggered a-IGZO TFT, 100 nm SiO2, W/L=100/10 um, VD=40 V
literature_input.project_mismatch: The project uses a symmetric dual gate, 30 nm physical Al2O3 on each side, 24 nm IGZO, ideal contacts, and a 0.01 V drain bias; source values constrain teaching sensitivities only.
literature_input.nomenclature_resolution: The paper equation and Table 1 classify NGA as acceptor-like, while the Figure 3 caption says donor-like. This contract follows the equation/table and preserves that conflict as a limitation.
literature_input.energy_reference_translation: Use epsilon=Ec-E in eV. The paper's conduction-tail equation becomes exp(-epsilon/WTA), and its Ec-E description places the Gaussian acceptor peak EGA below Ec.

tail.selection_rule: Use the reported lower point, Table 1 reference point, and upper point; retain 1e19 in provenance without adding a fourth formal device.

deep.selection_rule: Use the reported lower point, Table 1 reference point, and upper point; retain 1e17 in provenance without adding a fourth formal device.

occupancy_assumptions: local quasi-static equilibrium with the mobile-electron quasi-Fermi level
acceptor-like states are neutral when empty and carry one negative elementary charge when occupied
bulk_trap_model.effective_conduction_dos_source: config/tcad_t01_baseline.json teaching assumption; not the paper's 5e18 value
bulk_trap_model.electron_continuity_coupling: No trap generation-recombination term in this quasi-static first implementation; only the Poisson charge Jacobian couples to Electrons.
bulk_trap_model.charge_unit_derivation: DOS[cm^-3 eV^-1] integrated over eV gives occupied density[cm^-3]; multiplication by q gives C/cm^3.
bulk_trap_model.zero_density_limit: NTA=NGA=0 gives OccupiedBulkTraps=0 and exactly restores the trap-free T02-C Poisson charge expression.
limitations: Nc, bandgap, mobility, contacts, and background doping remain teaching assumptions rather than a jointly calibrated IGZO material set.
Local equilibrium occupancy has no capture cross section or time constant and cannot produce hysteresis or bias-stress dynamics.
Only acceptor-like NTA and NGA are included; donor-like NTD and NGD are deferred.
The source device and bias differ from this project, so the literature values are sensitivity inputs rather than project measurements.

energy_integration.implementation_rule: Generate nodes and weights once in Python, then emit the finite weighted sum and analytic Electrons derivative as DEVSIM node-model expressions.

execution_order: tail scan with NGA=0 and both interface D_it values zero
deep scan with NTA=0 and both interface D_it values zero
registered_hypotheses: Increasing occupied acceptor-like bulk states may increase the VTH and SS numerical proxies.
Increasing occupied acceptor-like bulk states may reduce common-bias mobile-electron density and drain-current proxies.
future_sensitivity.reason_hypotheses_not_gates: The literature stack, quasi-static occupancy, and project teaching material set differ, so convergence, conservation, zero-limit regression, extractability, and persisted evidence determine completion.

required_checks: 96-point quadrature agrees with an independent reference integration
zero trap density restores T02-C node charge and common-bias current
occupied trap density and analytic Electrons derivative are finite and nonnegative
physical trapped charge is nonpositive and DEVSIM node source has the opposite sign
all coupled solves converge and source/drain current is conserved
tail-only and deep-only cases produce a nonzero persisted response
